name: django-scaffold-frontend
description: django-scaffold 前端样式构建链（Tailwind CSS v4 + DaisyUI）

scripts.build:win: if not exist "static\css\dist" mkdir "static\css\dist" && tailwindcss -i static/css/base.css -o static/css/dist/base.css --minify
scripts.dev:win: if not exist "static\css\dist" mkdir "static\css\dist" && tailwindcss -i static/css/base.css -o static/css/dist/base.css --watch
